title: 第539章 你想屠村？
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林远听到喜羊羊肯定的回答后，眼中闪过了一抹异色。

之前沸羊羊曾告诉过他，慢羊羊需要每天吃肉。(第523章)

可现在，喜羊羊又说慢羊羊在监视着它们这些羊，还要处决了他们？

难不成，慢羊羊每天吃的肉是他们的？

但这与龙国给的提示和红太狼说的完全不同啊。

慢羊羊家里是有很多生物的皮囊，可唯独......没有羊的。

除了没有羊，其余的动物应有尽有，按照红太狼的描述，甚至里面还有七大饿狼等一系列与灰太狼有关的动物皮囊。

那么，处决这些羊的意义是什么？

喜羊羊啧了一声，道：

“灰太狼，看来你的大脑已经有些超负荷了。”

“居然会有这么多疑问啊！”

“不过也是，你并不知道青青草原发生了什么。”

林远皱着眉头看向喜羊羊：

“所以，你知道？”

喜羊羊眨了眨眼：

“我只知道一些大概，这些都是靠着我的洞察力分析出来的。”

“我想想，要从哪里给你讲起呢......”

林远抿了抿嘴唇，开口道：

“我现在只有四个疑问，第一个是如果村长要处决你们，为什么他的房间里没有羊的皮囊？”

“第二个疑问，慢羊羊房间里那些皮囊到底是怎么来的。”

“第三个疑问，懒羊羊如果吃下薯片再处决，能不能复活。”

“第四个疑问，小灰灰要怎么恢复心脏。”

“你也不用和我讲什么故事，本大王需要快速了解发生了什么。”

喜羊羊见状，摊手道：

“那这就好办了。”

林远缓缓点头，洗耳恭听。

“村长处决我们，未必是要吃了我们，而是拿我们的肉和皮毛，与某些东西交换。”

“至于能得到什么，我暂时不知道......不过可以肯定的是，他想处决我们，需要超过50%的羊认为我们该死，我们才能死。”

“所以村长的房间里并没有我们的皮囊。”

“第二个疑问，村长房间的皮囊，都是每次有羊在外面死后，慢羊羊变成诡异化的状态捕猎而来的......”

林远点了点头：

“这点我知道，他会让你们学习烹饪，然后再吃掉那些食物。”

喜羊羊有些意外地看了林远一眼，顿了顿道：

After Lin Yuan heard Pleasant Goat's affirmative answer, a strange color flashed in his eyes.

Boiling Sheep had told him before that Slow Sheep needed to eat meat every day.(Chapter 523)

But now, Pleasant Goat says that Slow Sheep is watching these sheep and wants to execute them?

Is it possible that the meat that Slow Sheep eats every day is theirs?

But this is completely different from the tips given by Long Guo and what Red Wolf said.

There are many skins of creatures in the house of Slow Sheep, but... there is no sheep.

Except for the absence of sheep, there are all the other animals. According to the description of the red wolf, there are even seven hungry wolves and a series of animal skins related to the gray wolf.

So what is the point of executing these sheep?

Pleasant Goat clicked his tongue and said:

"Big Big Wolf, it seems your brain is overloaded."

"There are so many questions!"

"But that's right, you don't know what happened in Qingqing Prairie."

Lin Yuan frowned and looked at Pleasant Goat:

"So, you know?"

Pleasant Goat blinked:

"I only know some general information. These are all analyzed based on my insight."

"Let me think about it, where should I start to tell you..."

Lin Yuan pursed his lips and said:

"I only have four questions now. The first is if the village chief wants to execute you, why is there no sheep skin in his room?"

"The second question is, where did those skin bags in Man Yangyang's room come from."

"The third question is, if Lazy Sheep eats potato chips and then executes her, can she be resurrected?"

"The fourth question is, how can Xiao Huihui recover his heart?"

"You don't need to tell me any stories. I need to quickly understand what happened."

Seeing this, Pleasant Goat spread his hands and said:

"Then this will be easy to handle."

Lin Yuan nodded slowly and listened attentively.

"The village chief executed us not necessarily to eat us, but to exchange our meat and fur for something."

"As for what he can get, I don't know yet...but what is certain is that he wants to execute us. More than 50% of the sheep need to think that we deserve to die before we can die."

"So there are no skins of ours in the village chief's room."

"The second question is that the skin bag in the village chief's room was hunted by the slow sheep in a strange state every time a sheep died outside..."

Lin Yuan nodded:

"I know that. He will make you learn how to cook and then eat the food."
